changesets.name: form-module-names.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-form": minor
---

### Breaking

- Rename `make` to `form` in `@shivaedev/effect-form/form.ts`; change the named import and calls from `make` to `form`.
- Move `emptyAsNull` from `@shivaedev/effect-form/optional.ts` to `@shivaedev/effect-form/emptyAsNull.ts`; change the import path and keep the `emptyAsNull` name.
- Move `statusOf` from `@shivaedev/effect-form/status.ts` to `@shivaedev/effect-form/statusOf.ts`; change the import path and keep the `statusOf` name.

changesets.name: public-story-imports.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/quality": patch
---

### Changed

- Let story kits import any workspace package's exported modules through package names or aliases without listing them in `tests/support-imports.options.modules`. Keep the allowlist for additional internal modules; packages without exports retain their existing boundary.

changesets.name: quality-global-hooks.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/quality": patch
---

### Fixed

- Keep all global Git hooks running after `quality hooks install`, including hooks added later, and prevent recursive pre-commit chaining. Report installations that hide global hooks with a reinstall repair hint; uninstall leaves global hooks in effect.
